name: riverpod_lint
summary: A developer-tool lint package for Riverpod that detects common Riverpod issues and offers Riverpod-specific diagnostics and assists.
advantages: Adds framework-aware diagnostics beyond generic Flutter lints
tradeoffs: pub.dev currently reports 3.1.9 with a Dart 3.13 dev minimum, so Dart 3.12 projects need a compatible earlier release
recommendedFor: Riverpod projects that want framework-specific static checks
Teams using Riverpod code generation and provider conventions

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata clearly exposes the latest release and SDK constraint.
